name: Cart_AddToCart_RefererFallback_Behaves
description:
What: When Referer points to product page, AddToCart redirects back; if from Cart, goes Home.
Steps:
1) Set Referer to '/Products/Details/1' -> LocalRedirect to that path.
2) Set Referer to '/Cart' -> RedirectToAction Home/Index.
Expected: Behaviors as described.
